answer: Fingerprints are counted in nadir, thus the distribution is public, and tundra lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a jade header, so 2014 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. Bonded capital sits idle for 4 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
